runtime.note: 后端、模型契约及前端资源来自启动时固定快照；任务数据与凭据独立使用原目录。Python依赖环境仍共用，不是完整依赖隔离。

checks: empty Chatflow offers opt-in scoped starter and does not prepare automatically
wrong-type preview response cannot be adopted or saved
full preview stays readonly and shows future model-cost and mock limitations
editing chosen reply invalidates full preview and acknowledgment
explicit adoption fills only unsaved editor with all branches and exact fixed reply
saving full plan records manual source, invalidates confirmation, and blocks replacement
same UI confirms saved configuration then builds and downloads native Chatflow DSL
refresh preserves saved full graph without external actions or automatic regeneration

limitations: Opt-in fixed-scope manual template for an empty Chatflow, not model-generated semantic planning or general requirement coverage.
Actual intent classification, extraction, retrieval relevance, grounded answer quality and Dify Sandbox execution are unverified.
Future native runs can call selected models and retrieval services and require original scope/budget gates.
Technical failures may still terminate; not all exceptions automatically transfer to a human.
Mock order data remain synthetic; dependency node binding and real service handoff still need user review.
No existing task migration, automatic import/publication/Key/run, or full business acceptance.
